title: Third special sitting of 2024

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2024/ޚޞ/3).
Economic Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 7/2023 (Companies Act).
Judiciary Committee report on the President's nominee for appointment as Prosecutor General.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The third special sitting was scheduled to take up committee reports on the Companies Act amendment and the Prosecutor General nominee, then vote on them.
